title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_10
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing correspondence, newspaper clippings, and internal memoranda regarding UFO sightings and the public's interest in the subject between 1965 and 1966. / This document is a collection of FBI case files (62-HQ-83894) regarding UFO reports, correspondence, and investigative records from 1967, including reports of abductions, historical sightings, and media clippings. / This document is a collection of FBI case file records (62-HQ-83894) concerning UFO reports, including correspondence with the public, internal memoranda, and reports of anonymous informant claims from 1967-1968. / This document is a collection of FBI case file records (62-HQ-83894) containing correspondence, internal memoranda, and administrative notes regarding public inquiries about UFOs and alleged government involvement between 1968 and 1969. / This document is a collection of FBI case file records (62-HQ-83894) regarding UFO inquiries, correspondence, and internal memoranda from 1969 to 1977, documenting the Bureau's consistent policy of non-jurisdiction over UFO sightings.

incidents.summary: A 17-year-old boy reported seeing a high-altitude object with white lights moving north from the southwest.
incidents.quote: saw a very high object with white lights heading north

incidents.summary: Two individuals observed an object over a home that stopped and changed colors from red to green to amber.
incidents.quote: lights changing from the color red to green and then amber

incidents.summary: A 15-year-old girl observed a motionless object near the John Lodge Expressway.
incidents.quote: stood motionless over the John Lodge Expressway

incidents.summary: A 39-year-old man observed an object with rotating lights.
incidents.quote: observed something with red, yellow and green rotating lights

incidents.summary: A 17-year-old girl observed an object that stopped twice and flashed lights.
incidents.quote: object stopped twice and lights started flashing

incidents.summary: Police Chief Joe Thorn reported seeing two UFOs, one under low cloud cover in daylight and another at 2,000 feet altitude.
incidents.quote: I have personally seen two of them

incidents.summary: James C. Collins reported being abducted by a craft manned by small creatures after observing it land in the street in Chesapeake, Virginia.
incidents.quote: observed a large oblong-shaped object which alighted in the street

incidents.summary: Paul L. Peyerl reported photographing a saucer-shaped aircraft in the Black Forest of Austria in 1944 while serving as a test pilot.
incidents.quote: saucer shaped, about twenty-one feet in diameter, radio controlled

incidents.summary: Fred Steckling filmed an armada of 40-50 UFOs while traveling by train between Mannheim and Frankfurt.
incidents.quote: Armada of about 40 to 50 UFO's appearing and disappearing in the middle of the blue sky

incidents.summary: At least 29 personnel at White Sands Missile Range observed one or more UFOs moving at high speed.
incidents.location_name: White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico
incidents.quote: silvery discs were flying at an altitude of 20,000 to 25,000 feet

incidents.summary: Two boys and a woman reported seeing red and green lights hovering over the Uplands residential district.
incidents.quote: saw a red and a green light hovering over what they thought was probably the area of the Uplands Golf Clubhouse

incidents.summary: An antimissile missile was fired at a UFO over Africa, but the object was protected by a force field.
incidents.quote: An antimissile missile was fired at a UFO over Africa on May 22, 1962, but the UFO was protected by its "force field."

incidents.summary: A UFO was detected by radar 22,000 miles from Earth.
incidents.quote: A UFO was detected 22,000 miles from earth by radar about August 6, 1967.

incidents.summary: A UFO was detected over Antarctica.
incidents.quote: A UFO was detected over Antarctica August 20, 1967.

incidents.summary: A UFO was detected over the Dewline and reportedly shot down.
incidents.quote: A UFO was detected over the "Dewline" in the past week and was shot down

incidents.summary: A report of a U.S. government capture of a saucer occupant, accompanied by a photograph of two alleged FBI agents and an alien.
incidents.explanation: The FBI stated the photograph does not represent Bureau employees and the matter is not within their jurisdiction; the photo is known to have appeared in European publications.
incidents.quote: a report that the F.B.I had captured a saucer occupant this was published in a flying saucer mag.

incidents.summary: Observation of an unusual object in the sky near Moorestown, New Jersey, which the witness associated with a subsequent plane crash in Elkton, Maryland.
incidents.explanation: The witness claimed the object was a missile camouflaged as a meteor or saucer; the CAB attributed the plane crash to a lightning strike.
incidents.quote: I claimed that the object which I seen was laying air mines and that this aircraft was destroyed by contact with one of these mines.

incidents.summary: Observation of a bright meteor (fireball/bolide) reported to the Harvard College Observatory.
incidents.explanation: Identified by Harvard College Observatory as a bright meteor or bolide.
incidents.quote: The object you saw was a bright meteor, sometimes called a "fireball" or a "bolide".

incidents.summary: A former CIA agent reported seeing flying objects and requested to speak with the FBI Director.
incidents.explanation: The individual was reported to be intoxicated and recently discharged from a psychiatric ward; no record of him as a CIA agent was found.
incidents.quote: Wood stated he is a former CIA Agent and wanted to report to the Director that recently he has been seeing flying objects.

incidents.summary: An unidentified object was recovered by Milwaukee police and reported to the FBI; described as metallic, jagged, and having an internal heat source.
incidents.quote: unidentified object had been recovered by Milwaukee police
